(b) On August 11, 2026, Brian Yoor notified iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (the “Company”) of his decision to resign from his position as a member of the Board of Directors of the Company (the “Board”) and as a member and chair of the Audit Committee of the Board (the “Audit Committee”), effective August 12, 2026. Mr. Yoor’s resignation from the Board was for personal reasons and not based on any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies or practices. The Board has appointed Karen McGinnis, a member of the Board and Audit Committee, as chair of the Audit Committee, effective August 12, 2026.
